summary: Recorded the Owner-directed split between canonical historical market truth and exact completed-run simulation state. Added G-HISTORICAL-REPLAY-01 and G-RUN-REPLAY-01; specified DS-005 MarketState, DS-006 persisted simulation evidence and RunState, and DS-007 ReplayFrame; bound WEB-PAGE-009 to market-only replay and WEB-PAGE-013 to completed-run replay; added one PLANNED successor, T109, replacing T069 and T105 while preserving their lifecycle, manifest, provenance, compatibility and artifact-rerun obligations; updated architecture, traceability, phase/plan collateral, plan-structure revision, intent_revision and spec_revision. No existing task contract, implementation code, test, workflow mechanism, status, attempt or approval evidence was modified.
rationale: The existing reconstruction and simulation paths already contain the required primitives but not the required durable product contract. ReplayOutput stores one PoolCheckpoint per replayed event (src/robinhood_lp/replay/output.py:36-60), replay_state_at_height selects the last checkpoint at or below a height (src/robinhood_lp/replay/state_comparison.py:1065-1091), and T041 supplies tick reconstruction, so MarketState can be a dataset-addressed composition rather than a new engine. T100 already references immutable underlying partitions instead of copying events. The T061 BacktestResult holds an ordered audit_events tuple and final PositionState (src/robinhood_lp/backtest/engine.py:210-223), but T069 publication reduces decisions to checksums, constructs only a final LedgerSnapshot (src/robinhood_lp/orchestrator/__init__.py:1774-1790), and the report builder receives only metrics, coverage and that terminal snapshot (same file:2052-2067); those artifacts cannot recover arbitrary historical strategy/position/accounting state. The current T105 manifest also embeds input_event_list for rerun (src/robinhood_lp/reports/manifest.py:468-469), duplicating the canonical market input in each result. The smallest coherent change is therefore one integrated successor, not another replay or backtest engine: T109 retains T069's only product-run lifecycle and T105's only manifest/report/artifact-rerun authority, moves new manifest input identity to immutable T100 dataset/partition references, persists only run-specific simulation evidence with sparse checkpoints plus deterministic transitions, and composes ReplayFrame at read time. One successor replaces both approved contracts because successful publication, manifest input identity and atomic evidence publication are one cutover; splitting them would create an interval with two incompatible success definitions or two publishers. Historical predecessor records remain byte-identical and explicitly non-replayable when evidence is absent. The Owner direction fully decides the product semantics, so no Owner question remains.

impact_assessment.intent: PROJECT_GOALS.md adds exactly two goals. G-HISTORICAL-REPLAY-01 defines MarketState(t) as reusable canonical historical truth independent of a strategy. G-RUN-REPLAY-01 defines RunState(run_id,t) as exact saved evidence from one completed simulation and ReplayFrame as same-cursor composition, forbidding strategy rerun, per-run market copies, parallel engines and a full snapshot at every point. intent_revision advances to v1-2026-09-21-historical-and-run-replay. No execution, risk, strategy-selection, support-level or live-promotion goal changes.
impact_assessment.specification: DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md adds DS-005 through DS-007: the canonical event cursor, dataset-addressed MarketState, immutable checksummed simulation evidence, sparse checkpoint plus transition RunState, and validated read-time ReplayFrame composition. WEB_CONSOLE.md makes WEB-PAGE-009's market replay consume MarketState while keeping its position hypothetical, and makes WEB-PAGE-013 consume ReplayFrame for exact completed-run history. ARCHITECTURE.md assigns T109 the existing application/backtest-runs and reports paths plus historical-replay/evidence integration and pre-annotates T069/T105 as superseded by T109 for the later SUPERSEDE route. spec_revision advances to v1-2026-09-21-historical-and-run-replay.
impact_assessment.contracts: No existing contract changed. One new contract, T109, replaces T069 and T105 and preserves all of their accepted obligations while adding the missing evidence and read contracts. It expressly retains one product-run lifecycle, one registry-bound manifest/report publisher, one stateless artifact-rerun boundary, T063 legacy compatibility, atomic publication and all prior fail-closed behavior. Ten existing contracts are recorded below: the two approved predecessors require annotation-only retirement after rewiring, and eight PLANNED consumers require CONTRACT amendments before they may run.
impact_assessment.dependencies: T109 depends on T041, T052, T061, T069, T100 and T105, is PLANNED at attempt 0, and declares replaces=[T069,T105]. The graph validates and is acyclic. Direct PLANNED consumers that must be repointed before retirement are T087/T088 for T069 and T073/T084/T107/T108 for T105. T103 needs a new direct T109 edge for MarketState despite its current transitive research-run path, and T096 needs T109 directly so the two new goals and successor evidence enter the final gate. Approved T101/T106 dependencies remain immutable historical evidence and do not need contract rewriting. The later safe order is CONTRACT-rewire the eight PLANNED tasks, SUPERSEDE T069 and T105 to T109, then implement/review T109.
impact_assessment.implementation: No application or test code changed. T109 authorizes adaptation of the existing T040/T041 reconstruction, T061 engine/accounting, T052 attribution, T069 orchestration, T100 dataset registry and T105 publication paths. Market checkpoints remain projections/caches, simulation evidence stores run-specific facts only, and ReplayFrame is a read-model composition. The old successful-publication path must become unreachable after cutover; no second replay, backtest, accounting, manifest, strategy or lifecycle implementation is permitted.
impact_assessment.data: Canonical market events remain in T031 partitions addressed through immutable T100 dataset versions and content hashes. New manifests reference that canonical input rather than embedding a complete input_event_list. Each new successful run atomically publishes immutable versioned simulation evidence containing ordered run-specific transitions and optional sparse complete checkpoints, with dataset/pool/range/strategy/engine/accounting/schema bindings and checksums. Existing T069/T105/T063 run records, manifests, reports, checksums and review artifacts remain byte-identical and readable; runs without the new evidence return explicitly unavailable RunState and are never regenerated with current strategy code.
impact_assessment.operations: T109 preserves queued/running/failed/cancelled/succeeded state, progress, reason codes, restart recovery, cancellation, CLI operation without Web and linked product reruns. Cutover is atomic across manifest, report and simulation evidence: all three publish successfully or the run cannot appear succeeded. Rollback restores an evidence-capable release or disables new successful publication, never the predecessor's complete-looking success path. WEB-PAGE-009 remains market-only/hypothetical; WEB-PAGE-013 becomes the exact completed-run scrubber; failed, cancelled, incomplete, legacy-only or binding-mismatched frames fail closed.
impact_assessment.security: The change adds read/evidence semantics only. Dataset, manifest and evidence identities confer no strategy registration, risk, approval, signer, execution, paper or live authority. Evidence excludes credentials, endpoint secrets and key material, Web authentication remains governed by existing console contracts, and no signer/execution/risk path or permission boundary changed.
impact_assessment.verification: Author-side investigation only, not approval evidence: tools.workflow validate returned OK; tools.check_imports returned no findings; tools.check_acceptance returned no findings; git diff --check is clean. The focused documentation/workflow suite produced 69 passed and one failure, tests/test_documentation_citations.py::test_check_passes_on_real_repository, caused by the pre-existing unresolved T069 architecture module path robinhood_lp.application.backtest_runs. The same single citation finding is present in the untouched main/base checkout, so A0022 adds no citation finding; after removing a newly introduced literal module citation from T109, the candidate citation result is exactly that baseline finding. T109 acceptance requires two heterogeneous pools, beginning/intra-block/end-of-block/range-end market queries, lifecycle cursor equality to original T061 state, no callback after strategy change/removal, sparse-checkpoint equivalence, checksum/binding failures, legacy unavailable behavior, atomic failure/cancellation behavior, one shared market timeline, and both predecessor success paths unreachable. Independent plan review remains required.

G-RUN-REPLAY-01 and DS-006 now require every new successful historical simulation to publish checksummed evidence sufficient for RunState without strategy rerun, so treating T069 as the current complete product-run contract would mislead a reader into publishing final-only results.
